title: dispatch-gates: `check-console-intercept-disarm` derives for no path, so a card that edits a package-root `vitest.config.*` learns it only in CI
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

## What happened

PR #29345 (seat 5) edited `packages/services/service-sms/vitest.config.ts`. That package's config had re-exported the shared preset, and the edit replaced the re-export with a spread. The card thread's local battery derived 70 commands, and all 70 exited 0 on that head. CI then read `Console-intercept disarm` red (the lint-ci-engine lane, 61/62): the gate wants a literal `disableConsoleIntercept: true` at the package root. That cost one fix round.

## Why the battery missed it

`scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` sits in the "undetermined" residue. Its row in `ROOT_WALK_RESIDUE_LEDGER` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`) says what it reads: every workspace package root's `package.json` and `vitest.config.*`. The row concludes that "a new test file under an existing package does not move it, a new PACKAGE does". That leaves out a case: an edited or new package-root `vitest.config.*` (or `package.json`) inside an EXISTING package moves it too. Because the row only exempts the gate from the whole-tree channel, no path derives it at all. The default output prints the residue only as a count; the names appear only under `--residue`.

## Ask

The population can be written as globs: a package-root `package.json` and `vitest.config.*` under the workspace globs. Place the family by path through the `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` idiom (or the table's equivalent), so that any card touching those files derives the gate. Update or retire the ledger row to match. The same applies to its `--self-test` row.

Acceptance: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` over a diff that edits only `packages/<any>/vitest.config.ts` lists `check-console-intercept-disarm`, and a diff that adds only a test file under an existing package does not.
